resources.string: You cannot start proving your identity in this app.
To start, go to the GOV.UK website and find the government service you need to use.
You’ll be asked to open this app if you need to use it to prove your identity.
If you’ve already started proving your identity on the GOV.UK website
If a service on the GOV.UK website has guided you to open this app, you should see a button to continue proving your identity in the ‘Home’ section.
If you cannot see the button, close the app and open it again.
